sourceName: National Health and Aging Trends Study
purpose: Record the exact evidence still required before NHATS R13/R14 variables can be used for the first aggregate functional-survival estimand.

currentDecision.reason: Official documentation provides variable naming conventions, candidate examples, survey-design concepts and source locations, but exact round-specific variable names, value labels, missing codes, file tiers and cohort-flow routing still require Colectica/codebook confirmation.

officialSourceFacts.fact: Cross-year metadata search is provided through Colectica and includes item numbers, variable names, labels, values, value labels and question text after separate registration.
officialSourceFacts.modelConsequence: Exact field selection must come from Colectica, codebooks or official crosswalks; prose examples do not authorize extraction.

officialSourceFacts.fact: NHATS public-use variables follow lower-case naming, use content-section prefixes, and use the third character to indicate round for round-specific variables; derived variables include a d marker and flag variables include an fl prefix.
officialSourceFacts.modelConsequence: Pattern-resolved names such as w13anfinwgt0 or cg13dwrdimmrc remain candidate names until confirmed against the selected file release.

officialSourceFacts.fact: The User Guide documents standard negative-value missingness codes such as refusal, don't know, inapplicable and missing.
officialSourceFacts.modelConsequence: No outcome, predictor, censoring or missingness table may be computed until these codes are mapped for every selected variable.

officialSourceFacts.fact: NHATS provides analytic weights and design variables, and the methods documentation discusses Taylor series and replicate-weight approaches.
officialSourceFacts.modelConsequence: Weighted or design-aware metrics require a preselected analysis weight, strata, cluster/PSU and variance method.

officialSourceFacts.fact: The NHATS/NSOC Conditions of Use prohibit data sharing with unregistered users and prohibit upload of NHATS/NSOC data to public LLM or AI platforms.
officialSourceFacts.modelConsequence: Only public documentation, synthetic examples or aggregate non-disclosive outputs may be used with AI assistance.

roundInstantiationRules.rule: Candidate names using # must be materialized separately for R13 and R14, then confirmed against official metadata before use.

cohortFlowTemplate.requiredEvidence: NHATS registration and public-use conditions confirmed outside the public repository.
One canonical R13 public annual file family and one canonical R14 follow-up file family selected.
R13 sample-person eligibility, interview route, residence route and design variables confirmed.
R13-to-R14 join key and follow-up status categories confirmed.
R14 death, alive/interviewed, known-alive-not-interviewed, proxy, residential-care, refusal/nonresponse and not-classifiable routes mapped.
Weight, strata, cluster/PSU and variance method fixed before any weighted metric.
Small-cell suppression and aggregate-only export check implemented.

readinessGates.requiredEvidence: Exact variable names, labels, value labels, missing codes and question text confirmed from Colectica/codebook.
Every # placeholder candidate materialized and checked for R13 and R14.
Cohort-flow table with baseline, follow-up, endpoint, censoring and disclosure rows complete.
Analysis weight, strata, cluster/PSU and variance method selected.
Negative codes, skip logic, proxy route and not-classifiable categories mapped for all selected fields.
No public AI upload boundary and small-cell suppression validator are operationalized.

prohibitedActions: download NHATS files from this matrix

treat pattern-resolved names as confirmed variables

emit row-level records, individual death dates, medical advice or personal longevity rankings
